Build a citation

txs_cite.Rd

Produces a utils::bibentry() suitable for printing or passing to format(). If x is a tibble returned by txs_get_tapr_file() (or its sibling functions), the citation references that specific file by source URL, retrieval timestamp, and short SHA-256 prefix. If x is a semantic TAPR object from txs_get_tapr(), the citation references the semantic pull and its source pages.

Usage

txs_cite(x = NULL, source = "tapr")

Arguments

x

Optional. A tibble returned by txs_get_*(). If NULL, returns a generic citation for the named source.

source

"tapr", "src", "aeis", or "peims".

Value

A bibentry.

Examples

txs_cite(source = "tapr")
#> Texas Education Agency (2026). “Texas Academic Performance Reports.”
#> Public data; accessed via the txschools R package.,
#> <https://tea.texas.gov/texas-schools/accountability/academic-accountability/performance-reporting/texas-academic-performance-reports>.
